sql.if: AND ( t2.prpty_nm ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{srchPrptyNm}, '%') OR t2.prpty_logic_nm ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{srchPrptyNm}, '%') )

choose.otherwise: ORDER BY t1.medata_set_id, t1.chg_aftr_rvsn DESC, t1.medata_chg_hst_id ASC

mapper.select: SELECT /* SQL_ID: .MetadataChgHstMapper.selectMetadataChgHstCount */ COUNT(*) FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_datachghst t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_property t2 ON t1.prpty_id = t2.prpty_id WHERE 1=1

SELECT /* SQL_ID: .MetadataChgHstMapper.selectMetadataChgHstList */ t1.medata_set_id , t1.chg_aftr_rvsn , t1.prpty_id , t2.prpty_nm , t2.prpty_logic_nm , t1.val_model_id , t3.model_nm AS val_model_nm , t1.chg_hst_div_mtcd , c1.mtcd_nm AS chg_hst_div_mtcd_nm , t1.chg_aftr_lang_mtcd , CASE WHEN t1.chg_aftr_geo_val IS NOT NULL THEN dtmeta.ST_AsGeoJson(t1.chg_aftr_geo_val) ELSE t1.chg_aftr_val END AS chg_aftr_val , t1.chg_hst_regr_id , t1.chg_hst_regr_nm , TO_CHAR(t1.chg_hst_reg_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS chg_hst_reg_dt FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_datachghst t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_property t2 ON t1.prpty_id = t2.prpty_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model t3 ON t1.val_model_id = t3.model_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code c1 ON t1.chg_hst_div_mtcd = c1.mtcd AND c1.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00010' WHERE 1=1

SELECT /* SQL_ID: MetadataChgHstMapper.selectSelValueListBySetIdForChgHst */ m1.medata_set_id AS medata_set_id , COALESCE(m2.prpty_id, m1.set_prpty_id) AS prpty_id , COALESCE(m2.val_model_id, m1.set_val_model_id) AS val_model_id , m2.medata_id AS medata_id , m1.set_rvsn AS chg_aftr_rvsn , m1.set_lang_mtcd AS chg_aftr_lang_mtcd , m1.set_medata_val AS chg_aftr_val FROM ( SELECT t2.medata_set_id , t1.mtcd AS set_mtcd , t1.mtcd_sort_odrg AS set_mtcd_sort_odrg , t4.prpty_id AS set_prpty_id , t4.range_model_id AS set_val_model_id , t2.medata_set_nwst_rvsn AS set_rvsn , CASE WHEN t1.mtcd = 'idString' THEN t2.medata_set_id WHEN t1.mtcd = 'nameString' THEN t2.medata_set_nm WHEN t1.mtcd = 'logicNameStringKo' THEN t2.medata_set_desc WHEN t1.mtcd = 'descStringKo' THEN t2.medata_set_nm WHEN t1.mtcd = 'statusCode' THEN t2.medata_set_sttus_mtcd WHEN t1.mtcd = 'statusCodeName' THEN t5.mtcd_nm WHEN t1.mtcd = 'createUserId' THEN t2.medata_set_regr_id WHEN t1.mtcd = 'createUserName' THEN t2.medata_set_regr_nm WHEN t1.mtcd = 'createDateTime' THEN TO_CHAR(t2.medata_set_reg_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) WHEN t1.mtcd = 'updateUserId' THEN t2.medata_set_amdr_id WHEN t1.mtcd = 'updateUserName' THEN t2.medata_set_amdr_nm WHEN t1.mtcd = 'updateDateTime' THEN TO_CHAR(t2.medata_set_amd_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) WHEN t1.mtcd = 'idSchmCountryCode' THEN t2.id_schm_cntry_cd WHEN t1.mtcd = 'idSchmType' THEN t2.id_schm_type WHEN t1.mtcd = 'idSchmCode' THEN t2.id_schm_cd WHEN t1.mtcd = 'idSchmCode2' THEN t2.id_schm_cd2 ELSE NULL END AS set_medata_val , CASE WHEN t1.mtcd = 'logicNameStringKo' THEN 'ko' WHEN t1.mtcd = 'descStringKo' THEN 'ko' ELSE NULL END AS set_lang_mtcd FROM dtmeta.tb_portal_code t1 INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset t2 ON t2.medata_set_id = #{medataSetId} LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT a3.data_type_mtcd, MIN(a1.prpty_def_id) AS prpty_def_id FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_propertydefine a1 INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_property a2 ON a1.prpty_id = a2.prpty_id AND a2.prpty_data_sttus_mtcd = 'use' INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model a3 ON a1.range_model_id = a3.model_id AND a3.model_data_sttus_mtcd = 'use' WHERE a1.domn_model_id = 'Class' AND a1.prpty_def_chg_yn = 'N' GROUP BY a3.data_type_mtcd ) t3 ON t1.mtcd = t3.data_type_mtcd LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_propertydefine t4 ON t3.prpty_def_id = t4.prpty_def_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code t5 ON t2.medata_set_sttus_mtcd = t5.mtcd AND t5.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00001' WHERE t1.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00013' AND t1.mtcd_use_yn = 'Y' AND t4.prpty_id IS NOT NULL ) m1 LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT t5.data_type_mtcd , t1.medata_set_id , t3.prpty_id , COALESCE(t6.val_model_id, t4.range_model_id) AS val_model_id , t6.medata_id FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset t1 INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model t2 ON t1.model_id = t2.model_id INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_modelproperty t3 ON t1.model_id = t3.model_id AND t3.model_prpty_del_yn = 'N' INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_propertydefine t4 ON t3.prpty_id = t4.prpty_id AND t4.prpty_def_chg_yn = 'N' LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model t5 ON t4.range_model_id = t5.model_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_data t6 ON t1.medata_set_id = t6.medata_set_id AND t3.prpty_id = t6.prpty_id WHERE t1.medata_set_id = #{medataSetId} ) m2 ON m1.set_mtcd = m2.data_type_mtcd ORDER BY m1.set_mtcd_sort_odrg
SELECT /* SQL_ID: MetadataChgHstMapper.selectMetadataDelHstListBySetId */ DISTINCT chg_aftr_val FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_datachghst WHERE medata_set_id = #{medataSetId} AND chg_hst_div_mtcd = 'del'

SELECT /* SQL_ID: MetadataChgHstMapper.selectMetadataRecentStatusBySetId */ chg_hst_div_mtcd FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_datachghst WHERE medata_set_id = #{medataSetId} AND chg_aftr_val = #{chgAftrVal} ORDER BY chg_hst_reg_dt DESC LIMIT 1
